extraction_warnings: PDF filename contains a typo 'Molluscsor' (missing space between 'Molluscs' and 'or'). Preserved verbatim in source_pdf as instructed.

PDF source uses 8-digit codes without dots (e.g., '16021000'). Normalized to NNNN.NN.NN format (e.g., '1602.10.00') per project schema. Subheading numbers in PDF (e.g., '160300') normalized to NNNN.NN (e.g., '1603.00').

PDF table-chrome headers ('Sl.No. Notes Notification Date Notification No', 'Itc(hs) Code. Description Export Policy Policy Condition', 'Main Notes', 'Sub-Heading Notes', 'Policy Condition', 'Product Description and Export Policy') were recognized as table headers and EXCLUDED from the legal notes per extraction rules.

Chapter Note 2 in the source PDF contains run-together words: 'any combinationthereof' (missing space between 'combination' and 'thereof'), 'preparation containstwo' (missing space between 'contains' and 'two'), and 'heading 2103or 2104' (missing space between '2103' and 'or'). Preserved verbatim as they appear in the PDF.

Sub-Heading Note 1 in the source PDF contains run-together words: 'food suitable for infantsor young children' (missing space between 'infants' and 'or'), 'For theapplication' (missing space between 'the' and 'application'), and 'may havebeen added' (missing space between 'have' and 'been'). Preserved verbatim as they appear in the PDF.

Policy Condition 2 (Halal certification) in the source PDF contains '?' characters in place of typographic quote marks (e.g., '?India Conformity Assessment Scheme(I-CAS)- Halal?', 'importing country?s requirements', 'Halal Meat &Meat products', 'mandated is as follows ?'). These are OCR/encoding artifacts from the source PDF — preserved verbatim as they appear in the source.
Policy Condition 2 text spans two PDF pages. The continuation text (beginning 'producer/supplier/exporter shall also meet...') was joined into a single note in the policy_conditions array.

Tariff line 1603.00.10 'Extracts and juices of meat' has Policy Condition text 'Export allowed freely but export to European Union allowed subject to the following conditions...' (Notification 34/2015-20 dated 13.01.2017). This is captured in policy_conditions. The continuation across pages includes references to CAPEXIL, Health Certificate, IEC No., etc., and uses '?' characters in place of typographic quote marks (e.g., '?Shipment Clearance Certificate?', '?Health Certificate?') — preserved verbatim.

Section IV title is 'PREPARED FOODSTUFFS; BEVERAGES, SPIRITS AND VINEGAR; TOBACCO AND MANUFACTURED TOBACCO SUBSTITUTES; PRODUCTS, WHETHER OR NOT CONTAINING NICOTINE, INTENDED FOR INHALATION WITHOUT COMBUSTION; OTHER NICOTINE CONTAINING PRODUCTS INTENDED FOR THE INTAKE OF NICOTINE INTO THE HUMAN BODY'. The section_notes capture the single Main Note of Section IV (definition of 'pellets').

Heading 1601 has a single 8-digit code '16010000' in the PDF without an intervening subheading row — represented as subheading '1601.00' with tariff line '1601.00.00'. Similar pattern at heading 1603 where subheading '160300' is present in the PDF.

Subheading 1602.30 ('Of poultry of heading 01.05') is not present as a top-level subheading row in the PDF — instead, the PDF lists three sibling subheadings 1602.31 (turkeys), 1602.32 (fowls of Gallus domesticus), and 1602.39 (Other) directly. The description 'Of poultry of heading 01.05 : -- <species>' is preserved verbatim on each tariff line.

Subheading 1602.40 ('Of swine') is similarly not present as a top-level row; siblings 1602.41 (Hams), 1602.42 (Shoulders), and 1602.49 (Other, including mixtures) appear directly with description prefix 'Of swine : -- <part>'.

Heading 1604: Subheading rows for 1604.10 (not present), 1604.11 (Salmon), 1604.12 (Herrings), 1604.13 (Sardines), 1604.14 (Tunas), 1604.15 (Mackerel), 1604.16 (Anchovies), 1604.17 (Eels), 1604.18 (Shark fins), 1604.19 (Other), 1604.20 (Other prepared/preserved fish), 1604.31 (Caviar), 1604.32 (Caviar substitutes). Subheadings 1604.12, 1604.13, 1604.14 have intermediate sub-subheading rows (no dotted code) in the PDF that expand into multiple 8-digit tariff lines; these intermediate rows are NOT separate subheadings and were not duplicated.

Heading 1605: tariff lines appear directly at 8-digit level under the heading without all intermediate subheading rows being displayed in the PDF. Subheadings reconstructed from the first 6 digits of each tariff code: 1605.10, 1605.21, 1605.29, 1605.30, 1605.40, 1605.51, 1605.52, 1605.53, 1605.54, 1605.55, 1605.56, 1605.57, 1605.58, 1605.59, 1605.61, 1605.62, 1605.63, 1605.69.
Tariff line 1604.18.00 (Shark fins) has Export Policy 'Prohibited' — the only non-Free tariff line in Chapter 16.

chapter_notes.text: This Chapter does not cover meat, meat offal, fish, crustaceans, molluscs or other aquatic invertebrates, as well as insects, prepared or preserved by the processes specified in Chapter 2 or 3, Note 6 to Chapter 4 or in heading 0504.

Food preparations fall in this Chapter provided that they contain more than 20% by weight of sausage, meat, meat offal, blood, insect, fish, crustaceans, molluscs or other aquatic invertebrates, or any combinationthereof. In cases where the preparation containstwo or more of the products mentioned above, it is classified in the heading of Chapter 16 corresponding to the component or components which predominate by weight.These provisions do not apply to the stuffed products of heading 1902 or to the preparations of heading 2103or 2104.

section_notes.text: In this Section, the term "pellets" means products which have been agglomerated either directly by compression or by the addition of a binder in a proportion not exceeding 3 (percent) by weight.

chapter_subheading_notes.text: For the purposes of sub-heading 1602 10, the expression "homogenised preparations" means preparations of meat, meat offal, blood or insects, finely homogenised, put up for retail sale as food suitable for infantsor young children or for dietetic purposes, in containers of net weight content not exceeding 250 g. For theapplication of this definition no account is to be taken of small quantities of any ingredients which may havebeen added to the preparation for seasoning, preservation or other purposes. These preparations may contain a small quantity of visible pieces of meat or meat offal or insects. This sub-heading takes precedence over all other sub-headings of heading 1602.

The fish, crustaceans molluscs and other aquatic invertebrates specified in the sub-headings of heading 1604 or 1605 under their common names only, are of the same species as those mentioned in Chapter 3 under the same name.

tariff_lines.policy_condition: Export allowed freely but export to European Union allowed subject to the following conditions : (i) A ?Shipment Clearance Certificate? is to be issued consignment-wise by the CAPEXIL indicating details of the name and address of the exporter, address of the registered plant, IEC No. of the exporter, Plant approval number, nature of export product, quantity, invoice number and date, port of loading (name of the port) and destination (ii) After the shipment is made, the exporter shall also provide a ?Health Certificate? consignment-wise to the buyer giving details of the product with HS Code, packaging, its origin, destination, vessel name, date of departure, health requirements, etc. This Health Certificate would be issued jointly by CAPEXIL and Regional Animal Quarantine Officer, Department of Animal Husbandary, Dairying and Fisheries, Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India.
